title: Come Thou Almighty King
lyrics_original: Help us Thy Name to sing,
To Thee, great One in Three,
And to eternity love and adore!

bible_verses.english: Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns!” The world is also established. It will not be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
I saw until thrones were placed, and an Ancient of Days sat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool. His throne was fiery flames, and its wheels burning fire.
I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!”

devotional.prayer_english: Almighty King and Ancient of Days, I invite You to reign over my heart and mind today. Help me to sing Your praises not just with my voice, but through a life surrendered to Your love. Scatter my fears and guard my soul with Your almighty power. May Your glorious presence fill my day with joy and worship. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Almighty King and Ancient of Days, I invite You to reign over my heart and mind today. Help me to sing Your praises not just with my voice, but through a life surrendered to Your love. Scatter my fears and guard my soul with Your almighty power. May Your glorious presence fill my day with joy and worship. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: When we sing "Come, Thou Almighty King," we open our hearts to the God who reigns over all creation and time. As the Ancient of Days, He holds our lives with victorious power and tender care. Worship is not something we accomplish in our own strength; we ask Him to help us praise Him rightly. Today, invite the Father to take His rightful throne in your life, trusting that His glorious reign brings peace and victory over every fear.
